subject: Request: bridge credits + trial extension to accommodate procurement
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@aegis.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Trial top-up and credits request to bridge procurement delay

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team loved how Redwood handled streaming and our bursty inference patterns. Procurement has flagged a longer-than-expected legal review and we won't be able to sign a commitment before our existing trial credits exhaust next week.

Two asks:
- Can we get a 6-week trial extension so our infra team can validate the VPC deployment and latency in our staging cluster?
- Would Redwood consider a one-time promotional credit ($20k) to keep the integration testing going while procurement finishes?

We're preparing an internal rollout plan (attached) and expect a decision in ~6 weeks. The commitment size we're targeting is $250k ARR in year one if the pilot metrics hold. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of Product, Aegis Robotics
[Attachment: aegis_mvp_scope.pdf (PDF)]
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@aegis.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 13:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trial top-up and credits request to bridge procurement delay

Emma — really glad the demo landed well. Appreciate the transparency on procurement timing.

We can put together a proposal to bridge the gap. Initial internal idea (needs exec sign-off):
- 6-week trial extension
- One-time promotional credit of $20,000 applied to the account to keep testing moving
- Conditional 25% discount on first-year committed spend if Aegis signs >= $200k ARR within 90 days of the pilot close (subject to legal & finance)

I've attached the pricing worksheet with the above sketched out. Can you confirm the target signals you expect from the pilot (latency P95 < 250ms, 95% success rate for streaming sessions, sample volume)? We'll reference those in the mutual action plan.

If that works, I'll escalate for approval and loop in our CRO.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-pricing-worksheet.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial top-up and credits request to bridge procurement delay

Team — forwarding Aegis' ask. TL;DR: they want a 6-week extension + $20k credit while procurement completes. They have strong technical engagement and a clear path to $250k ARR if pilot metrics hold. Deal ID: DEAL-4582.

Why this matters:
- Strategic fit: Aegis integrates Redwood into our edge-device workload patterns; early win could unlock multiple robotics customers.
- Timeline: procurement ~6 weeks; without credits their trial will expire and we risk them switching back to competing stacks.

Proposed approval ask (what I'll present formally):
- Approve 6-week trial extension + up to $20,000 promotional credit (one-time)
- Approve a 20–25% first-year discount tier contingent on $200k+ ARR commit within 90 days
- Condition: sign mutual action plan + pilot success signals (latency P95 < 250ms, error rate < 5%)

Attachments: mutual action plan draft included. I recommend approving the credit + weekday signoff so we can send it today.

Neha

Thanks for the context, Neha. I reviewed the MA P and the projected ARR. I'm comfortable approving an exception with a slight tweak to protect Redwood economics:

Approval (executive sign-off):
- Approve a one-time promotional credit of $15,000 (not $20k) to bridge staging/testing.
- Approve a 20% discount on the first year if they commit >= $200k ARR within 90 days of pilot close.

Conditions:
- Customer signs the mutual action plan and provides the pilot signal screenshots (latency/error metrics) at pilot completion.
- Finance will require the deal be recorded with deal id DEAL-4582 and a formal SOW or order form.

Neha — please send the updated offer back to Aegis and include a DocuSign link for the credit application and order form. I'll sign off on the execution if finance checks out.

-Vivek
